title: Getting Started — A Beginner's Guide
description: Brand new to browser games? This quick guide walks you through controls, settings, and how to find games you'll love.

modules.body:
## Welcome

This guide walks you through everything you need to get the most out of browser games.

## Controls

Most games use the arrow keys or WASD for movement. You can also use a connected controller — most modern games support gamepads natively.

## Where to start

If you're new, jump straight into the [Sample Runner](/g/sample-runner) game above to see how everything works.
